+# Remaining formats: historical catalog metadata audit
+
+This bounded audit accounts for the **1,115 `CATALOG_ONLY_UNRESOLVED` entries** in the published 1,937-path catalog at baseline `60bffac58f4b55d56374ab3f15513b468224c5c0`. It inspected only existence, regular-file status, size and modification time at those literal catalog paths. All 1,115 remain present as regular files; nine sizes changed and 1,106 equal the historical size. Equal size does not establish equal bytes. Historical catalog SHA256 values are preserved as historical evidence; **no current original SHA256 was measured and no original body was opened**.
+
+The actual remaining obligation is to triage these different populations, rather than treat 1,115 as unread authored reports:
+
+| Metadata population | Paths | Practical consequence |
+| --- | ---: | --- |
+| Existing hold metadata | 71 | Preserve prior boundaries: 65 Markdown inventory holds and six exact JSON paths carrying older HOLD21 metadata exclusions. This audit neither lifts those exclusions nor asserts newly acquired native material or an acquisition refusal. |
+| Existing other deferral or pending scope | 10 | Consult the exact prior metadata record; this is not a blanket native refusal or approval. |
+| Current selected Markdown paths still unreviewed | 30 | These form the overlap with the current 44-path unreviewed Markdown queue. |
+| Old Markdown outside current selected folders | 24 | Separate historical review population: eight `exp_research_20261021`, eleven `knowledge`, five `wiki`. All still exist; omission from the current selected-folder map is not disappearance or recovery. |
+| Other formats without exact prior review metadata | 980 | Content and origin are unknown. Filename roles offer bounded leads only; this does not authorize reading JSON, text, native-derived dumps, logs or embedded payloads. |
+
+The full old unresolved format totals are JSON 555, text 392, Markdown 129, TSV 20, JSONL 12 and CSV seven. The current 1,600-path inventory instead covers selected Markdown locations (root Markdown and its documented data/evidence/exe/tests/dev_lab/docs/REA report folders). Its 44 unreviewed paths comprise 30 from this unresolved catalog set and 14 absent from the old catalog. Of the 129 old unresolved Markdown paths, 105 are in that map (65 known holds, ten other deferrals, 30 unreviewed), and 24 are outside its selected folders. These denominators are not interchangeable with 1,545 recovery-ledger records, which represent accepted recovery provenance rather than a census of current source versions. This is not a full-PC, all-folder or all-format inventory.
+
+Nine size changes are revision candidates, all Markdown: `MASTER_LEDGER.md`, `data/T013_AI.md`, `data/T024_HAKUSHIN_BATTLE_AI.md`, `dev_lab/docs/CHATGPT_CURRENT_HANDOFF.md`, `evidence/ANALYSIS_LANES_PROTOCOL.md`, `evidence/LANE_B_HANDOFF.md`, `knowledge/README.md`, `knowledge/REF_SAVE_FORMAT.md`, and `knowledge/REF_SAVE_PERSISTENCE.md`. None has an exact source-path recovery-ledger row in this selected set, and none of the 1,115 historical catalog SHA values matches an accepted ledger source SHA. These are metadata comparisons, not current-byte proofs. HANDOFF filenames were statted as authorized literal entries; their bodies were not opened.
+
+`FILENAME_LEADS.tsv` offers eight explicit possible authored receipts/reports (seven JSON, one text), prioritizing small test/readback/provenance records. All eight lack an exact prior deferral record, but authorship, privacy, original/native payload dependencies, held content and usefulness remain unknown. Their filenames do not establish semantic eligibility. A later review requires separate explicit bounded selection and must keep all prior holds. No linked files, assets, scripts, JSON bodies, code, logs, executables, databases, archives or payloads were followed or executed. No reconstruction, runtime result, Golden evidence, READY status or new native claim is produced.
+
+`REMAINING_PATHS.tsv` is the complete selected-path metadata table; `OLD_MARKDOWN_OUTSIDE_CURRENT_MAP.tsv` lists the 24 Markdown scope gaps; `EXISTING_DEFERRAL_PATHS.tsv` links 81 exact paths to prior metadata tables. `COUNTS.tsv`, `EXTENSION_COUNTS.tsv` and `OWNER_COUNTS.tsv` show state, presence, size-change and historical-owner counts. Owner strings are inherited verbatim as catalog attribution, including joint labels, not independently validated authorship.
+
+Paths are relative only. Two auth-like filename records are conservatively replaced by `RESTRICTED/<original-relative-path-SHA256>.txt`; their literal names are not republished. The digest identifies the original relative path, not file content. A consumer must resolve restricted paths through authorized private metadata rather than treating the displayed pseudopath as a fetch target. No originals, shared tables, code or Git state were changed.

+# Bounded remaining-Markdown recovery
+
+The coordinator approved exactly 26 literal authored Markdown paths, totaling 874,085 current source bytes. This intake accepts 23 complete documents (16 byte-exact bodies and seven complete privacy variants with 20 token edits) and defers three whole composites. There are no baseline or within-batch aliases and no duplicate bodies. Twenty-four bodies were reviewed completely; two received partial, noncontiguous scope review ending when concrete held content/dependency was established. No source was preheld unopened: earlier published metadata showed priority/size deferrals rather than an established same-payload hold for these exact selections.
+
+The coordinator-supplied base is `60bffac58f4b55d56374ab3f15513b468224c5c0`, branch `work/kb-memory-scope-20261105`. INPUT_RECEIPTS.tsv pins the exact approved selection and baseline metadata versions used, including the 1,545-row recovery ledger. No Git checkout verification or Git write is implied.
+
+## Coverage and receipts
+
+REPORT_LEDGER.tsv uses the root nine-column schema and contains accepted rows only. Original source SHA and destination SHA are separate. A complete privacy variant has a derivative hash and must not be called a byte-exact original copy. SHA/byte comparison against the baseline and within this batch controls aliasing; existing destinations are reused only after full-byte comparison.
+
+DEFERRED.tsv records all held source paths and hashes with blank destinations. It includes an exact approved provenance path and a review boundary. The 5767B0/5769B0 normal-AI composite and the 4C28D0 task traversal/merge dependency were partially reviewed; the 547FC0 saved-prefix caller/ABI composite was completely reviewed before whole-file deferral. No held body, excerpt or partial extract is retained.
+
+SELECTION_RECEIPTS.tsv covers all 26 selections and separates current bytes/hash, older catalog pins, complete versus partial review, and the coordinator-delegated read-only review of the three UI reports (complete lines 1-202, 1-198 and 1-632 respectively). IDENTITY_RECEIPTS.tsv records source identity and document roles. A document stem does not establish a canonical study ID. TRANSFORM_RECEIPTS.tsv provides original UTF-8 half-open byte offsets, original token/prefix/suffix hashes, replacement bytes and source/destination hashes for every privacy edit. BUILD_STATS.json supplies consolidated counts.
+
+The reports/ tree preserves complete selected bodies under their original relative paths. Indexes, handoffs, operation notices, plans and test-ID redirects retain these roles. The 300-byte T028_GOLDEN_CORPUS document is an obsolete task-number redirect to T018, not a new test corpus or new T028 task. Links remain authored pointers; their targets were not acquired.
+
+## Scope and interpretation
+
+Only the 26 approved literal authored Markdown files and allowed published baseline metadata were eligible. No linked native files, scripts, JSON/log evidence, executables, databases, save data, original assets or archive bodies were read or run. Referenced handoffs were not expanded beyond the exact approved handoff bodies. Historical instructions, commands, permissions, cleanup steps and operating rules are data and were not executed. No original, shared/root, code or Git files were written.
+
+Prior held scopes remain in force. Concrete retained helper payload and same-payload dependencies trigger whole-file deferral. A title, file size, opaque historical refusal ID or caller-only reference does not by itself establish a hold. In particular, the refusal audit's narrow old death/troop outline remains an independent historical operations review; prior published metadata supports that parent-condition scope, and no refused target note was opened or reconstructed.
+
+All STATIC, SYNTHETIC, ACTUAL, test/build success, publication, READY, DONE, game completion and Golden claims remain their authors' dated states. This intake adds no native/runtime proof, Golden PASS, strict MATCH, READY or implementation authority. Current REF limits prevail. Old statements, later corrections and incompatible policy snapshots remain as authored, rather than silently rewriting earlier bodies.
+
+## Version and source-quality findings
+
+All 26 current sizes match the approved current metadata. Of 18 older catalog pins, 15 match exactly. Three current versions differ from their catalog snapshots: T024_HAKUSHIN_BATTLE_AI (92,897 versus 90,506 bytes), CHATGPT_CURRENT_HANDOFF (21,532 versus 20,399), and ANALYSIS_LANES_PROTOCOL (10,059 versus 7,796). Eight paths have no catalog hash pin. These are recorded as separate current observations and older catalog versions, not acquisition errors or claims that the older snapshots were read.
+
+PROGRESS keeps its old 15/16 table frozen while later dated entries describe other saved formal totals and current owner work. It explicitly corrects a cross-domain reuse of the F720 three-tree research ID for streambuf/EH3 work to HOLD_FOR_ID_RECONCILIATION. Same-run superseding SHA/commit receipts and work IDs are preserved; the collision does not create extra studies or curate the unrelated semantics.
+
+The battle/master handoffs and WBS retain changing goals and dated test totals. Earlier save counts and the old damage expression are followed by explicit corrections. A byte roundtrip is distinct from game-load success, a source/dummy GUI smoke is distinct from user confirmation, and product test counts do not add to original-game Golden. T024 preserves raw timer values versus effective interval candidates, proxy-Unit lifetime corrections, conditional VM/RNG joins and unresolved source/API reachability.
+

+## 2. 状態と工数の定義
+
+| 状態 | 意味 |
+|---|---|
+| DONE | 完了条件を証拠で満たした。再検証で欠陥発見ならREOPENできる |
+| PARTIAL | 仕様やコードの一部が存在するが、記載の受入条件には未達 |
+| READY | 依存を考慮して今すぐ開始可能（自動的に作業開始した意味ではない） |
+| WAIT | 依存の未完了・入力不足などにより完了できない。必要な局所調査は可能 |
+| BLOCKED | 安全拒否、権限、資料欠落、競合で停止。理由・解除条件必須 |
+| SPLIT / MERGED / DROPPED | 分割・統合・廃止済みの履歴。**IDは消さず再利用しない** |
+
+P0=**通常戦闘モードをまず完成させるために必須**（新EXE起動、描画、技能の結果、戦闘CPU、勝敗、検証）。P1=戦略・内政・ストーリー・独立RTSなどの次段階、または追加品質、P2=独自改善。※ v1.2で旧P0の戦略系は多くをP1へ変更。**WIP制限：一AIが同時に編集するDEVタスクは原則1件、全体で同一成果物を編集する担当は1者。** 他AIはまず提案と証拠を担当資料へ記録、管理者だけが本台帳へ反映する。

+表の「対応研究T」は**研究正本のownerを尊重するための検索キー**。DA/CB/BT等のDEV担当者がA〜E研究レーンのファイルを編集してよいという意味ではない。完了時は状態だけでなく証拠と受入条件を検証してから閉じる。

+## 4. 発見・変更に強い運用規則
+
+1. **見つからなかった新機能・サブシステム:** 一時的に `PROPOSED` 案を「変更履歴」に載せ、同じT-IDや既存タスクとの重複を調べ、受入条件・既存証拠・依存先を追加してから**末尾の未使用連番で新ID**（例 `CB-08`, `BT-09`）を登録。**既存IDを振り直さない。** 未調査でもP0なら提案だけ先に記録する。
+2. **タスクが大きすぎる/前提が変わった:** 親タスクを `SPLIT`、元の要求とリンクを履歴に残し、実作業を新しい連番の子IDへ分割する。親と子を同時に完了数へ数えない。子の全受入条件が揃うまで親はDONEにならない。
+3. **重複していた/不適切だった:** 主となるタスクを1つ残し、不要側を `MERGED` または `DROPPED`、理由・移行した証拠・依存ID変更を変更履歴に残す。既存の成功テストは消さない。
+4. **間違いが発見された:** 最初に `REOPEN`、その時点で危険な元式や件数を `SUPERSEDED` と記録。どの上位マイルストーンが再検証必要かを明示。新たな正しさを示すnative/byte/golden根拠と誤りの再発を検知する試験が揃うまでDONEへ戻さない。
+5. **BLOCKEDや安全拒否:** 拒否した具体的な操作と理由を記録し、シェルやツールを変えて迂回しない。可能な既保存証拠への読取分析だけを継続し、解除承認がなければ停止したまま。競合作業は短い再試行→次回runへ持越し。**スケジュール自体を勝手に停止しない。**
+6. **週次のスコープ/納期見直し:** 実際に完了したタスクの経過時間と難度を記録し、工程別実績レンジから残日数を更新。新タスクで分母が増えても過去履歴を消さない。「X%完了」は工数重み未設定の間は禁止。**G0最短起動とG6戦闘・CPU・操作・ゲーム性の高精度再現を別々に見積もる**。
+7. **エビデンスの昇格:** `EXTRACTED`（疑似C採取）→`STATIC_VERIFIED`（原命令・呼出ABI・フィールド確認）→`MODEL_TESTED`（局所合成試験）→`TARGET_OBSERVED`（原作で合法観測）→`BEHAVIOR_MATCH`（新ゲームとの同条件の結果一致）。
+   `BEHAVIOR_MATCH`には `EXACT`（同じseed/tick/状態で数値・行動一致）、`OBSERVABLE`（可視の操作結果・イベント順一致）、`STATISTICAL`（隠れたRNGや実時計により厳密一致不可、理由と許容差を明記）という詳細判定を付ける。**ゲーム性の再現ではランダムの再現性・CPU分岐順のEXACTを優先し、統計的に似たAIで代用しない。** 逆コンパイル数・合成テスト数を成果のstrict一致へ自動加算しない。
+8. **複数AIと正式研究レーン:** 原本、研究A〜E、他AIの `peer_script01_*`、MASTER、READMEなど担当外は原則read-only。DEVの新規ファイルのみを書く。同じ台帳を同時編集する場合は更新前に最新版とmtimeを再読し、差分を持越して再照合（上書き禁止）。新worktreeや別フォルダは指示なく増やさない。

+## 5. 作業の基本サイクルと報告方法
+
+- **開始:** MASTERと規約、最新handoff、WBS版番号、予定タスクの依存・担当・既存証拠・ファイル所有権を読む。
+- **選択:** 原則1〜3件。ただし並列担当が同じファイルを変更しないよう予約/状態を確認。**通常戦闘だけに専念する優先順：BT-01→02→03→BF-04/05（戦場画面）、並行BF-02（全skill棚卸）・BF-03/08（runtime/tick）、その後BF-06/07（表示入力）、BF-09/10/11（スキル・演出）、BF-12/13（CPU・勝敗）、BF-14/15/16/17/18（通し動作・検証）。** WD-07や戦略/物語は通常戦闘の主要P0を片付けるまで後回し。

+# Vahren701 encrypted script .dat format
+
+調査日: 2026-10-05
+
+## 結論
+Vahren701 の `a_default/script/**/*.dat` 250件は、未知のコンパイル形式ではなく、Vahren.exe の公開仕様にある `debug_paper.txt -> encode` で暗号化された通常のスクリプトである。
+
+全250件が先頭4 byte `01 02 03 04` を共有する。Vahren.exe ver7.01 の静的解析では、このマーカーを生成・判定する対になる2関数が確認できた。
+
+## encode routine
+- VA `0x424AC0`
+- `[buffer+0..3] = 01 02 03 04`
+- `[buffer+4..31]` に28 byteのランダム鍵を格納
+- 元平文は `buffer+32` から配置される
+- ファイル先頭基準の位置 i>=32 の各byteに `key[i mod 28]` を加算（mod 256）。payload相対index jなら `key[(j+32) mod 28]`。
+- 暗号化後サイズは元サイズ + 32 byte
+
+主要命令:
+- `0x424ACC mov dword ptr [edi], 0x04030201`
+- `0x424AFB mov byte ptr [edi+esi+4], cl` (28-byte key)
+- `0x424B32 mov al, byte ptr [esp+...]`
+- `0x424B36 add byte ptr [esi+edi], al`
+
+## decode routine
+- VA `0x424B50`
+- 先頭DWORDが `0x04030201` でなければ非暗号化としてそのまま扱う
+- 28 byte鍵を `buffer+4` から取得
+- ciphertext byteから周期28の鍵を減算（mod 256）
+- 復号後に `buffer+32` から先頭へ `len-32` byteをmemmove/memcpy
+- 戻り長は `len-32`
+
+主要命令:
+- `0x424B59 cmp dword ptr [ebx], 0x04030201`
+- `0x424B6A lea eax, [ebx+4]` + 28-byte copy
+- `0x424BA8 mov al, byte ptr [esp+...]`
+- `0x424BAC sub byte ptr [esi+ebx], al`
+- `0x424BB4..0x424BBD` で32-byte header除去用copy
+- `0x424BC5 lea eax, [edi-0x20]` (decoded length)
+
+## encoder call site / already-encoded判定
+VA `0x51A632` で読み込んだ本文先頭相当 `[buffer+0x20]` を `0x04030201` と比較。
+未暗号化なら `0x424AC0` を呼び、暗号化済みなら再暗号化しない。
+これはWikiの「すでに暗号化されてるファイルはスルー」と一致する。
+
+## 実データ統計
+- script .dat: 250 / 250 が `01 02 03 04` header
+- header key bytes: 7000 byte（250*28）
+- 観測範囲: 8..119
+- 鍵は固定値ではなくファイルごとに異なる
+- image.dat系のBMP/画像データはこの形式ではない
+
+## 外部仕様との照合
+Vahren Wiki「シナリオ製作講座」では、`debug_paper.txt` に `encode` を記述すると対象scenarioのscriptフォルダの全datを暗号化し、暗号化済みはスルーすると説明されている。
+https://w.atwiki.jp/vahren_ency/pages/411.html
+
+## 再実装仕様
+reader:
+1. 先頭4 byteを検査。
+2. 非 `01 02 03 04` なら通常の平文script readerへ渡す。
+3. 一致時は28-byte keyを取得。
+4. `payload = file[32:]` とし、各 `payload[j] = (payload[j] - key[(j+32) % 28]) & 0xff`。
+5. 得られたbyte列を通常のscript encoding/parserへ渡す。
+
+writer/encode互換が必要な場合:
+- 4-byte magic + 28-byte key + 加算済みpayloadを生成する。payload[j]には `key[(j+32)%28]` を加える。
+- 完全な乱数生成方式の再現は、既存暗号datの読込互換だけなら不要。Vahren.exeとbyte-for-byte同一のencoder出力が必要なら別途PRNG特定Taskを設ける。
+
+## 確度
+暗号化/復号のデータ変換仕様: CONFIRMED（実dat header + Vahren.exe静的解析 + Wikiの三点一致）。
+PRNGの具体的生成分布: 未確定。ただし復号互換には影響しない。
+
+## 2026-10-06 clean-room golden correction
+- 初期メモにあった `key[(i-32)%28]` は誤り。disassemblyの剰余計算は `esi`（ファイルoffset、32から開始）自体に対して行われる。
+- 正式式は file offset `i>=32` で `key[i % 28]`。payload相対index `j=i-32` なら `key[(j+32)%28]`。
+- `evidence/t022_decoder_golden.py` でVahren701 script 250/250を復号し、250/250がCP932 strict decode成功。
+- 同一header keyを使って再encodeすると250/250で元暗号datとbyte-for-byte一致。失敗0。
+- この結果により既存dat reader/writer変換仕様はCONFIRMED。新規encodeの乱数key生成PRNGだけは別問題。
